  <h2 id="criteria-title">Cross-cutting criteria</h2>
  <p>These criteria come back in challenges, the exam and the project.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="reading-map">
  <article><h3>Reproducibility</h3><p>The document or repository makes it possible to understand and rerun the essential steps.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Readable code</h3><p>Objects have clear names, transformations are structured and unnecessary code is removed.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Relevant graphs</h3><p>Visual choices serve the question: titles, axes, units, legends and scales are carefully handled.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Careful interpretation</h3><p>Conclusions state what the data support, without going beyond what is observed.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Communication</h3><p>The deliverable is understandable for someone who does not see you working.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Following instructions</h3><p>The right file is submitted, in the right place, with the requested elements and without unnecessary files.</p></article>
  </div>
